title: The Monthly Press: October 2026
html:
Hey developers!

I'm not launching rocket cars or making quantum computing breakthroughs (yet), but I made a lot of changes to Git Pushups. Hopefully you love them all:

  • All features are free:
    • My goal with this project is to have fun and get developers moving.
    • You may remember that hackathons from last year inspired me to monetize the app early on. I don't think it's a good product fit.
    • All paid subscribers will receive a refund for this year (thank you for supporting the project!)
    • You can now support the project by sending me a tip
  • Apple Watch is live:
    • Leave your phone at home and get your pushups in with the watch app alone
  • Customize how often you get blocked
    • You can now block yourself from coding multiple times per day. See our installation instructions at gitpushups.com
  • Some basic email loops
    • I don't like spam, but emails do serve as a good "accountability buddy".
    • You'll get one (like this!) every month unless you opt out.
  • Better website design
  • GitHub issues resolved:
    • #21: Android app link
    • #20: Apple Watch support
    • #13: Paywall padding (thank you @LoganWeir)
    • #14: One-liner install script (thank you @ibash)
    • #6: Claude Code / Cursor integration and setup instructions (thank you @cronin)
    • #19: Replace subscriptions with donations or one-time payments (thank you @LoganWeir)
    • #23: Machine-discoverable interface
    • #28: SEO improvements — canonical homepage URL, automatic HTTPS redirects, and a clearer search description (thank you @Shpigford)

That's all, team! Thank you for doing (over 40K!) pushups with me!

—Justin
markdown:
Hey developers!

I'm not launching rocket cars or making quantum computing breakthroughs (yet), but I made **a lot of changes** to Git Pushups. Hopefully you love them all:

- **All features are free:**
  - My goal with this project is to have fun and get developers moving.
  - You may remember that hackathons from last year inspired me to monetize the app early on. I don't think it's a good product fit.
  - All paid subscribers will receive a refund for this year (thank you for supporting the project!)
  - You can now support the project by [**sending me a tip**](https://buy.stripe.com/eVqbJ025S91j9gJ4rnabK00)
- **Apple Watch is live:**
  - Leave your phone at home and get your pushups in with the watch app alone
- **Customize how often you get blocked**
  - You can now block yourself from coding **multiple times per day**. See our installation instructions at [gitpushups.com](https://gitpushups.com)
- **Some basic email loops**
  - I don't like spam, but emails do serve as a good "accountability buddy".
  - You'll get one (like this!) every month unless you opt out.
- **Better website design**
- **GitHub issues resolved:**
  - [#21: Android app link](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/21)
  - [#20: Apple Watch support](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/20)
  - [#13: Paywall padding](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/13) (thank you [@LoganWeir](https://github.com/LoganWeir))
  - [#14: One-liner install script](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/14) (thank you [@ibash](https://github.com/ibash))
  - [#6: Claude Code / Cursor integration and setup instructions](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/6) (thank you [@cronin](https://github.com/cronin))
  - [#19: Replace subscriptions with donations or one-time payments](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/19) (thank you [@LoganWeir](https://github.com/LoganWeir))
  - [#23: Machine-discoverable interface](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/23)
  - [#28: SEO improvements — canonical homepage URL, automatic HTTPS redirects, and a clearer search description](https://github.com/higgins/gitpushups.com/issues/28) (thank you [@Shpigford](https://github.com/Shpigford))

That's all, team! Thank you for doing (over 40K!) pushups with me!

[—Justin](https://x.com/justinprojects)
